facts.claim: 我与 Kay 在西塔底层办公室找到 Genevieve，她正翘着脚躺在沙发上闭目养神。
facts.quote: We found Genevieve in the West Tower. Her office was on the ground floor

facts.claim: Kay 举起手机请求录音，称这是标准程序，Genevieve 一口答应。
facts.quote: Do you mind if I record this? It’s standard procedure.

facts.claim: Kay 开场为她的丧亲之痛致歉，Genevieve 先误以为指的是 Deirdre 之死。
facts.quote: Let me begin by saying how sorry I am for your loss

facts.claim: Genevieve 说她知道 Deirdre 昨晚威胁过她，是 Abi 今早告诉她的。
facts.quote: I know about her threatening me last night.

facts.claim: 她称失眠难耐，便开车出门兜风，两点离开、四点回来。
facts.quote: I left at two and came back at four, give or take a few minutes.

facts.claim: 被追问门锁时她承认用钥匙开过门，但不记得是否重新锁上。
facts.quote: I think I did. I can’t remember doing it, but it’s what I usually do.

facts.claim: Kay 索要车钥匙以便检查她的车，Genevieve 起身过快差点晕眩，仍交出了钥匙。
facts.quote: We’re going to need to inspect your car,” Kay said gently.

facts.claim: 她说前门共有四把钥匙，分别在她、Rose、Abi 和 Dan 手里。
facts.quote: Four,” replied Genevieve immediately. “I’ve got one and so does Rose.

relations.rel: Genevieve 同意让 Belle 与 Kay 一同参与问询
relations.quote: If you think it’ll help, I have absolutely no problem with it.

relations.rel: 两人仍约定继续合写回忆录项目
relations.quote: It doesn’t mean we can’t work on our project

relations.rel: Abi 把 Deirdre 的威胁转告给 Genevieve
两人各持一把前门钥匙
relations.quote: I’ve got one and so does Rose.

relations.rel: Dan 持有最后一把前门钥匙但从不使用
relations.quote: Dan has the last one, even though he never uses it.

relations.rel: Kay 认可 Belle 有办案经验、两人搭档
relations.quote: Belle’s got experience with this sort of thing.

numbers.quote: I left at two and came back at four, give or take a few minutes.

numbers.claim: Kay 追问她两点出门时外门是否锁好
numbers.quote: when you left the house at two o’clock, was the door to the outside locked?

numbers.claim: Kay 追问她四点回来时是否同样用钥匙开门
numbers.quote: when you came back at four? Used your key to unlock the door?
I’ve got one and so does Rose.
Dan has the last one, even though he never uses it.

numbers.claim: Kay 与 Genevieve 谈“你们两个”是否合作
numbers.quote: And I take it you two are working together?

numbers.claim: 出门时间只有几分钟误差
numbers.quote: give or take a few minutes.

numbers.claim: 她第一次显出耐心耗尽
numbers.quote: her patience wearing thin for the first time

numbers.claim: 她从钥匙圈上拧下最粗的一把
numbers.quote: She twisted off the fattest one among them

numbers.claim: 她只在尸体出现的那一夜才去开车
numbers.quote: until the one night a corpse showed up

turning_point: 转折点是 Kay 索要车钥匙、要检查 Genevieve 的车：问询从“你昨晚在哪”的不在场陈述，转为对物证的搜查，Genevieve 也从配合的证人变成可能留下痕迹的嫌疑人。
notes: Genevieve 起身后头晕，原文并列 head rush 与 panic attack 两种解释，未定；F6 原文写作 I—I think I did，引用从 I think I did 起截；F1 的 quote 结尾落在 ground floor，原句在后文继续。
